significance: The smallest of the Pancha Rathas at Mahabalipuram, cut from a single rock around 650 CE under the Pallavas and shaped like a thatched hut. Its sanctum holds Durga as Mahishasuramardini, and it forms part of the UNESCO-listed monuments of the town.
story: The monument is popularly named for Draupadi, shared wife of the five Pandavas of the Mahabharata, although the article notes that history does not support the name.
